name: Micah Hassan
episode: The last light at the harbor
life: “I still remember recognizing a missing neighbor from four unlit windows.” Tuesday often includes a stop at the public end of the South Shore boardwalk, where Micah checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I run the marina. I didn't understand how many people check on each other without passing through my office.
appearance: Micah has a high puff tied with plain cord, a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek, and a favorite piece of clothing, a plum-colored cardigan. It usually goes with a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole. When somebody else has the floor, Micah presses the lips together to keep a smile in.
personality: Micah admires skill and distrusts the idea that skill gives anyone permission to be rude. Micah learns fastest from somebody willing to show how they made a mistake.
agenda: To learn who looks after whom beyond the office door.
family: Lennon Adair is Micah’s stepsibling. Micah chooses the music. Lennon puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The waiting-room plant*, Lennon says, “I gave it the name of my favorite aunt. My other aunt just found out and wants a pot of her own.”
connections: Ashley West (dock porter). The night porter and the marina manager compare who still needs company after the office closes.

reactions.situation: A cabin light stays on after its usual time
reactions.response: Micah checks in through an ordinary contact before treating the late light as an emergency.

reactions.situation: A stranger waves a phone camera in a crying person's face
reactions.response: Micah asks the person crying whether they want to go somewhere quieter, leaving them control over the next step.
